name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-09-22, at wavelengths from 1.08 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
